## Context

README says `cd BLT-NetGuardian-Client` and `flutter run` with no platform folders; CONTRIBUTING clones `github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/BLT-NetGuardian-Client.git`.

## What to do

1. Use `git clone https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git` and `cd BLT/blt-netguardian-client`.
2. Add `flutter create .` before `flutter run`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Steps work from a clean clone
- [ ] No github.com clone URLs remain

## How to test locally

```bash
Follow the README.
```
